label: Bible Study
prompt: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the _____.
verse: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
note: The Preacher's famous shrug — 'under the sun' is his signature phrase, and nothing under it is new.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy _____, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
verse: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
note: The LORD looks at fearful Gideon and says: go in this thy might — strength God could already see in him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And let fall also some of the _____ of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
verse: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
note: Boaz told his reapers to drop extra handfuls 'of purpose' for Ruth — kindness disguised as carelessness.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The stone which the builders _____ is become the head stone of the corner.
verse: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
note: Jesus quotes this after the parable of the tenants — the rejected stone became the cornerstone.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God _____ reigneth.
verse: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
note: 'Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth' — the words Handel set in the Hallelujah Chorus of Messiah.
